To tackle these problems, we propose a communication-optimized framework for training ML models on networks with limited resources. Our approach reduces communication requirements by dividing data into smaller, local chunks and processing them within individual nodes before sharing results with the master node. Based on these findings, we provide practical recommendations for choosing the right communication metric and making informed decisions about training resources.
